title: Dispensing valve for packaging
abstract: A self-sealing dispensing valve for fluid product packaging with a flange, valve head having an orifice, and resiliently flexible connector sleeve. When pressure is applied, the sleeve rolls outward so the orifice snaps open; when pressure releases, the valve snaps closed and retracts.
gist: A self-sealing silicone valve for squeeze containers: squeezing the bottle pushes the valve head out and its slit opens; releasing the pressure snaps it shut, so upside-down bottles neither drip nor leak.
